disclaimer: This record documents a data inconsistency for investigation. It is not a survey, not an elevation certificate, and not evidence of correct elevation. Only PE/RLS-certified elevation documentation resolves this inconsistency.

inconsistency.datumNote: Both values nominally NAVD88; datum transformation error alone cannot explain 13.2 ft difference.
inconsistency.deltaNote: Material difference exceeding typical LiDAR vertical accuracy (±0.3 ft RMSE for QL2). Indicates one or both values do not represent the same ground point, or a blunder exists.
inconsistency.lidarDemSource: Indiana GIO 2020 statewide LiDAR DEM, tile IN2020_26850945_12, 2.5 ft resolution, EPSG:2968, NAVD88
inconsistency.ownerSuppliedLagNote: Owner-supplied, uncertified. Working checklist value, not newly certified.
possibleCauses: Coordinate precision — site coordinate may not fall on the building footprint
DEM represents bare-earth terrain; LAG is lowest adjacent grade at structure
Temporal change between 2020 LiDAR collection and LAG observation

resolutionRequired: PE/RLS-certified elevation documentation (MT-1 Form 2 / Elevation Certificate). FEMA Additional Information request dated 2026-09-22 already requires this; 90-day track ends 2026-12-21.

site.description: Bonebank anchor site, 13101 Bonebank Road, Point Township, Posey County, IN
